title: Phase Noise
text: Apply receiver phase noise to complex baseband signal, 1 input, 1 output; {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise level, {Frequency offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offset, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate 1e6, {Initial seed}, {View Filter Response} displays magnitude response of filter and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)
params.values: Phase noise level [-80 -100] (default) | vector of negative scalars

params.name: Frequency offset (Hz)
params.values: Frequency offset [2000 20000] (default) | vector of positive increasing values

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Initial seed of noise generator 2137 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: View Filter Response
params.values: Display magnitude response of filter button

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
